name: The Inquisitor's TIE Advanced
description: The Inquisitor's TIE Advanced was the personal TIE/ad v1 prototype TIE fighter entrusted to the Grand Inquisitor in his mission to hunt down Jedi for the Galactic Empire.

data.name: The Inquisitor's TIE Advanced
armament: Projectile launcher that fired XX-23 S-thread trackers
data.crew: 1 as standard, 2-3 in cramped and unintended quarters
